title: Nairobi Gallery – National Museums of Kenya

facts.fact: The gallery is at the Kenyatta Avenue/Uhuru Highway roundabout beside Nyayo House.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: located at Kenyatta Avenue and Uhuru Highway roundabout next to Nyayo house

facts.fact: The gallery houses Joseph and Sheila Murumbi collections, including textiles, jewellery, art and postage stamps.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: home of Joseph and Sheila Murumbi’s collections ... books, textiles and costumes, jewellery, African artifacts

facts.fact: The former colonial administration building includes the Point Zero hall and changing art displays.
facts.evidenceExcerpt: octagonal dome hall (point zero) ... Temporary Art exhibitions
